author: JahyGamer
quote:
“In Grand Theft Auto VI, the relationship meter (often called the loyalty meter) is a four-tier system that tracks how romantically close Jason and Lucia are, shifting dynamically based on how much time and effort you put into them as a couple.“

That’s all you really need to know why this deserves a 0. This is not a GTA game it’s more like a Sims game with really good graphics. The story is bland and you are forced to stay in a relationship with a Woman who’s just a terrible person all around. She’s the typical “girl boss” and Jason acts like her simp. Feels like more of a female fantasy werewolf Novel than a GTA title. Also they took out a lot of features such as no more girls for hire, no more weapons wheel, can’t hijack emergency vehicles, can’t buy businesses, no stock market, no rampage mode, a lot less freedom. 0/10 do not waste your money
